title: UI Kit
summary: The studio interface system: short-edge canvas rule with a density floor, CSS-pixel type and touch targets, token-driven slice9 art generator, theme, and the widget layer every screen is built from.
dependencies: neotolis-engine nt_ui widgets, atlas, and Clay
consumer-owned pack builder for the nine kit regions
provides: ui_tokens_t design tokens with a studio default sheet
ui_scale_fit short-edge canvas rule with a density floor and cap
ui_frame_begin / ui_metrics per-frame sizes in UI units and CSS pixels
ui_theme_init token-driven engine styles in g_ui_theme
ui_kit panel/tile/scrim/label/button/meter widgets and the UI_LAYER_* order
gen_ui_kit.py slice9 art generator driven by a token sheet

White circle with a deep rim; slider thumb and milestone dot.
